internal_only: CI fixture, not a product offering. The routing sentinel pulls a real catalog model on every PR across three operating systems, so it has to be small (708 MB) and it has to STOP: measured 2 tokens in 1.6s on a one-word prompt, where qwen3.5-0.8b produced 17,787 tokens in 58.5s and timed the boot benchmark out. It emits real structured tool calls (waired-ai/waired-agent#322: greeting and search clean over three trials, one under-claim on read-file), which the sentinel does not need today but a future leg that drives an actual tool call would. At 352M it produces nothing worth giving anyone, so it is withheld from every picker, catalog view and docs table while staying resolvable by id or alias.
